newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list options on EPIC Design, others.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list options on EPIC Design, others.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Wednesday it would list options on EPIC Design Technology Inc and UroMed Corp on October 4.
The PHLX also said it would list options on First American Corp and NeoPath Inc on October 7.
EPIC Design options will open with strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. The stock was unchanged at 24-3/4 Wednesday morning.
Initial expirations will be in October, November, February and May.
For UroMed, opening strikes will be 10, 12-1/2 and 15, with initial expirations of October, November, January and April.
UroMed shares were up 5/8 at 11-3/4 Wednesday morning.
First American options will have opening strike prices of 45, 50 and 55. The stock was off 1/4 at 47-3/4.
Initial expirations will be in October, November, December and March.
NeoPath options will open with strikes of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. NeoPath shares were up 1-1/8 at 21-1/4.
Initial expirations on NeoPath will be in October, November, December and March.
Paul Dry & Co will be the specialist for Epic Design and UroMed options. TFM Investment Corp will be the specialist for NeoPath. Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist for First American.
